subject.why: The bouquet features three red roses wrapped in pink paper with a bow and a small hanging blank heart tag as specified.

category.why: The bouquet floats at a slight angle with no ground or surface, set against a saturated yellow radiating sunburst background.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, border, watermark, or character present.

framing.why: The object is centrally placed with comfortable, clear margins on all sides.

colour.why: Warm, juicy, vibrant colours with strong contrast between the bouquet and the yellow-orange background.

detail.why: The shapes are simple and chunky with no micro-textures, noise, or unnecessary secondary elements.

style.why: The 3D render perfectly matches the reference art style with smooth rounded volumes, soft lighting, and a gentle satin sheen.
